spec.summary: Language-neutral protobuf wire identity. Only what decides wire compatibility is hashed: field numbers, cardinality and types. Field names, message/enum member names, comments, formatting and declaration order are excluded.
spec.kinds: "rpc" hashes the (request, reply) pair a method declares. "event" hashes a payload that has no reply: the output half is always the empty message, so canonicalOutput is {"f":[]} and the reply type a schema source demands (inputMessage/outputMessage on such a vector) never reaches the identity.

messageDescriptor.f: Array of field descriptors, sorted ascending by field number. Always present, `[]` for an empty message.
messageDescriptor.o: Array of oneof groups: {"f":[field numbers ascending]}, groups sorted ascending by their first number. Omitted when the message has no oneof group. A proto3 `optional` field is NOT a oneof group.
messageDescriptor.r: Flat table of every message/enum reachable transitively from this message's fields, keyed by fully-qualified name with a leading dot, keys sorted lexicographically. A message entry is {"f":...,"o":...} with no nested "r". An enum entry is {"e":[value numbers, ascending, duplicates collapsed]}. A message reachable from itself appears here too. Omitted when empty.

fieldDescriptor.t: scalar name exactly as written in .proto ("string", "int32", "int64", "uint32", "uint64", "sint32", "sint64", "fixed32", "fixed64", "sfixed32", "sfixed64", "bool", "float", "double", "bytes"), or "m:<.full.Name>" for a message, or "e:<.full.Name>" for an enum. For a map field this is the VALUE type.
fieldDescriptor.k: map key type (always a scalar name). Present only when c=="map".

spec.mapEntries: Synthetic protobuf map-entry messages never appear in `r`; a map is expressed inline through c/k/t.
spec.canonicalJson: Object keys sorted lexicographically at every level, array order preserved, no whitespace, no trailing commas. Numbers are plain integers.
spec.emptyHash: A handler registered without a schema declares the empty string as its contract hash. The empty string is a valid value and matches only the empty string.

notes: Runtime stores the hash opaque and never recomputes it; it only compares equality when routing Invoke to instances.

The two schema sources (.proto and .schema.json) are NOT expected to agree with each other — .schema.json derives nested message names from field names, so a caller and a callee must use the same source kind (ADR 0001).

vectors.name: scalars
vectors.covers: every protobuf scalar type, one field each

vectors.name: scalars_renamed
vectors.covers: same wire shape as `scalars`, every field name changed

vectors.name: scalars_renumbered
vectors.covers: same as `scalars` with field 15 moved to 16

vectors.name: scalars_retyped
vectors.covers: same as `scalars` with field 3 changed from int32 to int64

vectors.name: scalars_recardinalized
vectors.covers: same as `scalars` with field 14 changed from singular to repeated

vectors.name: sparse_numbers
vectors.covers: non-sequential field numbers up to the protobuf maximum

vectors.name: sparse_numbers_reordered
vectors.covers: same fields as `sparse_numbers`, declared in a different order

vectors.name: complex
vectors.covers: nested messages, transitive references, enum, repeated, scalar map, message map, oneof, proto3 optional

vectors.name: enum_alias
vectors.covers: enum with allow_alias — duplicate numbers collapse

vectors.name: cyclic
vectors.covers: self-reference and mutual recursion between messages

vectors.name: empty_message
proto3_optional_and_oneof
vectors.covers: proto3 optional stays `opt` and is not a oneof group; a real oneof is

vectors.name: proto2_required
event_payload
vectors.covers: event identity: the reply half is the empty message, and the reply type the schema source demands is left out

vectors.name: json_schema_renamed
vectors.covers: same as `json_schema` with every leaf field renamed; message-bearing field names kept because .schema.json derives nested message identity from them

properties.name: field names are not part of the identity
declaration order is not part of the identity
leaf field names are not part of the identity (.schema.json)
changing a field number changes the identity
changing a field type changes the identity
changing a field cardinality changes the identity
